items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Red Happy played with O'Rell Wilde, with King Oliver, I remember Wilde.

ctx.x: Do you remember Red Happy was supposed to be with Oliver sometime? Red Happy. Did you know?
Was he and I do? Red Happy, yeah. Red Happy played with O'Rell Wilde, with King Oliver, I remember Wilde.
What about Ernest Rogers? Was he playing?
